exposure: family history of high blood pressure
cohort: The study included 166 pre-eclamptic patients and 166 normotensive pregnant females from Pakistan.
finding: The SLC19A1 (rs1051296 G>T) CA and AA genotypes were significantly associated with an increased susceptibility to preeclampsia, and low folic acid along with the CA genotype was identified as a high-risk factor.
cross-section timing: Maternal venous blood samples were obtained between 20th and 40th weeks of gestation.
